method: Execute unchanged classic app.js in Node VM; hydrate input/button nodes from its actual rendered HTML, dispatch the real document click/change/input listeners and observe GameUI.getState(). Optional domain fixtures overlay only the initial defaults clone. Minimal DOM harness does not emulate layout.
limitations: No browser layout, accessibility tree, GPU, native gameplay or persistence execution.
The minimal DOM handles rendered form controls and synchronous event feedback; it is not a general browser DOM.
Timers are queued as no-op handles; none of the requested business acceptance cases depends on elapsed time.
State comparison excludes generic scenario surfaces, the outer state banner and page heading; meaningful text/control/image changes are required.
